title: Reading Drill — Studying book exchanges on stations — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Studying book exchanges on stations — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Millcross began with reports of popular shelves filling with books in poor condition. The exchange volunteer had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using sample checks and chose the share of books suitable for exchange as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was a clear condition notice. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted six weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded station closure times as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
